mission_07: Hybrid quantum-classical models combine classical neural network layers with quantum circuits, leveraging the strengths of both paradigms. Classical pre-processing transforms raw inputs into a format suitable for quantum encoding, the quantum layer processes data in an exponentially large Hilbert space with entanglement, and classical post-processing extracts and combines quantum features into final predictions. This architecture is practical for near-term quantum devices: the quantum circuit can be small (few qubits, shallow depth) while the classical layers handle the bulk of computation. In this mission, you implement a three-stage hybrid model with classical pre-processing (linear + ReLU), quantum processing (encoding + variational layers + entanglement), feature extraction via Z expectation values, and classical post-processing (linear output layer).
